kind.instructions: Classify item.title and item.body. Prefer governance for doctrine, receipts, or honest posture. Prefer security only for vulns or secret exposure.

criteria.bug: Something broken in source, CI, or rendered claims.
criteria.question: Needs an answer, not a change.
criteria.security: Vulnerability, leaked secret, or unsafe verification claim.
criteria.governance: Doctrine, receipts, proof counts, provenance, claim honesty.

claim_risk.instructions: Merging or publishing item could assert Lambda-as-theorem, inflated locked-proven, SLSA L3, or a second flagship.

secret_risk.instructions: item or item.files suggest credentials or private key material would land in git or a Space.

actionable.instructions: Enough concrete detail exists to act without guessing.

ready_to_merge.instructions: From item only, a PR looks ready. Do not assume CI is green unless item.ci says so.

urgency.instructions: Time sensitivity for maintainers of public evidence.
criteria: This week; visible but not breaking honesty.
Blocking: outage, secret, or false proof claim on a public origin.
